key_concepts: Percentage composition is the mass fraction of each element in a compound multiplied by 10
Percent composition can be calculated from a chemical formula using atomic masses and mola
Percent composition can be calculated from experimental mass data.
Subscripts in a chemical formula indicate the number of atoms or moles of each element.
Molar mass is the sum of the atomic masses of all atoms in the formula.
Percent composition values for a compound should total 100%.
Hydrochloric acid is 2.77% hydrogen and 97.23% chlorine by mass.
A zinc and oxygen compound with 24.12 g zinc in a 30.00 g sample is 80.40% zinc and 19.60%
Percent composition is useful for determining empirical formulas.
Nutrition labels can be analyzed for percent by mass of protein, fats, and carbohydrates.
